reviewed_claim: Official HNX article 60005646, dated 2019-08-08, says TIE was delisted from HOSE on 2019-08-01 and was to begin UPCoM trading on 2019-08-09. Signed HNX Notice 872/TB-SGDHN independently states first TIE trade on 2019-08-09 and 9,569,900 shares. The stored 2019-07-31 prior trade endpoint is the positive-volume VCI bar and last effective session before the official cessation date; the HNX article does not separately call it the final trade date.

HOSE signed Decision 520/QD-SGDHCM, dated 2022-07-28, states the LCM final HOSE trading day was 2022-08-26, delisting became effective 2022-08-29, and 24,633,000 shares were delisted. Signed HNX Notice 2754/TB-SGDHN independently states first UPCoM trading on 2022-09-09 and 24,633,000 shares; official VSDC notice 152362 confirms the HOSE-to-UPCoM data transfer and 24,633,000 shares. The HOSE decision is an official signed document captured from a Vietstock mirror; the VSDC and HNX official records corroborate its identity and quantities.
